reuse.why: Adds the rule to the existing isSkippedByMonthAction predicate and parses the notes with the shared extractTagsFromText helper instead of hand-rolled tag matching.

duplication.why: The rule itself exists once; only the notes join/column is added to both pre-existing data queries (getMonthActionCategories and getBudgetData), which already mirrored each other.

placement.why: The predicate and the data it needs live in budget/actions.ts next to the other month-action exclusions.

scope.why: Touches only the month-action selection and its tests.

maintainability.why: One named predicate (isFixedCostGroup) inside the single skip function every month-wide action calls; easy to own.

one_place.where: isFixedCostGroup inside isSkippedByMonthAction in packages/loot-core/src/server/budget/actions.ts, called by copyPreviousMonth and all set* month-wide actions
